text: Nadia starts at the council on Monday, first proper office job since uni. Remind me to text her good luck the night before.
ayo got the promotion!! team lead from 2 November 2026. his wife Chidi already booked a table for saturday
Jonah's retiring end of March 2027 after 31 years at the depot. Dont forget to chip in for his leaving present, Kevin is collecting.
Need to pick up dry cleaning tomorrow before 5 and drop the parcel at the post office.

Call with Hana. Her last day at the bakery is Friday, she's gutted to leave but the new place pays way more and it's ten minutes from her flat. Starts there Monday 26 October. Her mum keeps telling her she's mad to give up the early finishes. She's also learning Portuguese on the side, which I did not know. Ask her how the first week went.
Nia mentioned she's into bouldering now, goes Tuesdays and Thursdays with her flatmate.
Kiara's leaving do is cancelled, her boss moved it to a team lunch instead. Not going to bother.
So um Yasmin rang, she's really nervous about her first day at the hospital next Tuesday, says she barely slept. Remind me to message her that evening to see how it went.
Chioma's brother Rhys is moving to Leeds in a fortnight for a new job at a law firm
Ilse - new manager role at the gallery, started last week. Ask her how the first week went when I see her Sunday.
Book MOT for the car, renew the passport (expires March 2027!), and sort the gutter this weekend.
Mateo got let go from the warehouse on Friday. He was quiet about it but his partner said he's really struggling. Should take him for a pint next week.
Paolo's daughter graduates on 14 July 2027 and he's already planning the dinner
Saanvi's interview for the senior analyst job is tomorrow at 10. remind me to wish her luck tonight and then text her the day after to find out.
oliver and nora both handing in notice on the same day lol. Oliver is off to a startup in Bristol, Nora's going freelance. Their dog Biscuit is going to his mum's for a bit while they sort things
Amy's first day as a deputy head was today. Sounded shattered but happy.

Remember Sophie said her husband Patrick retires in December, after 35 years teaching chemistry. Big party planned for Saturday 12 December 2026 at the cricket club, she's organising it all and stressing about the guest list. He wants to do woodwork when he's done, she reckons a set of chisels would go down well. Should get a card the week before.
Seo-yeon passed her probation! Permanent from next month
reggie mentioned his nan's 90th is this weekend, whole family going up to Durham

Amir left his job at the bank last Friday. Going back to study architecture in September 2027, he got the place at the Bartlett. Wants to be a set designer eventually, has done some bits for an amateur theatre. His partner Oliver is covering the rent for now. Said he should have done it ten years ago. Don't forget to send him that book on stage design.
Michael's work drinks for his tenth anniversary at the firm got called off, half the team has covid.
Catalina - started at the vet practice Monday. Her cat Pepper went with her for a checkup on day one, which she thought was hilarious. Kavya (her sister) is apparently jealous of the staff discount.
Get milk, bin bags, birthday card for work.
Abebe and his wife are expecting, due in April 2027. He's also just been made foreman. Big year for them. Send congrats.
Sadia's dad has his hip op on Thursday. She's taking the day off to drive him. Remind me to check in with her on Friday morning.
Darius loves vinyl, mostly old soul. Said he'd kill for a first press Al Green, gift idea for later.

Talked to Rhys at football. He's been passed over for the promotion again, third time this year. Pretty fed up, thinking about leaving altogether. Might look at the fire service, applications open in January 2027 and there's a fitness test in March. His girlfriend Moira thinks he should just go for it. His dad was a firefighter so it runs in the family I guess. Check in with him next week, he seemed low.
Moira's PhD viva is Wednesday 4 November 2026. She's terrified. Must text her the morning of.
Nadia Okafor from the old team just messaged - she's leaving the agency end of the month. Leaving drinks next Thursday at the Crown.
ayo's induction went fine apparently, he said the training is a lot of slides

Note to self. I start at the new place on 9 November 2026. Before then: get a lanyard photo done, sort the train season ticket, return the old laptop to IT by Friday, and finish the handover doc. Tuesday 3rd is my last day here, so leaving drinks probably that night. Buy a decent bag this weekend, the old one is falling apart.
Kev (Kevin) said his boss is retiring in January and he might get bumped up. Fingers crossed for him. Ask him in a few weeks if anything's been announced.
Hana's moving to Lisbon in March 2027 with her girlfriend, both found remote jobs
Chat w Nia. Starts new teaching post after half term. Her son Jonah starts reception at the same school, so they'll be doing the school run together. Cute.
Remind me: Kiara's driving test Monday. Text good luck Sunday night, and ask her how it went Monday evening.
Chidi's wife Yasmin had the baby on Tuesday! Little girl, Ada. Both doing well. need to get a gift before we visit next weekend
dentist 3pm thurs, then gym. Clear out the spare room saturday.
Ilse's husband Mateo has just been offered a job in Munich, starts 1 February 2027. She hasn't decided if she's going. Bit torn about it.
Paolo Petrov is going part time at the garage from next month so he can look after his mum. He sounds exhausted.
Saanvi is vegan and hates coriander. Note for the dinner.

Voice note. Uh, just had coffee with Oliver. He got the job at the museum, the curator one he's been on about for ages. Starts the week after next. His partner Amir is throwing a little celebration for him Friday night, I'm bringing dessert. Oh and he mentioned his mum's been in hospital for tests, nothing serious they think, but he's waiting on results. Should text him on Monday to see if they came back.
Nora said Sophie's retirement do was lovely. Wish I'd gone.
Amy's brother Reggie has his first shift as a paramedic on Saturday 7 November. She's more nervous than him
remind me to ring Patrick the day after his leaving lunch, he'll want to talk it through
Wedding dress fitting moved to next Friday. Also need to call the caterer back.
Seo-yeon got a place on the graduate scheme at Suzuki, starting September 2027. Remind me to send her flowers this week.
Michael Tanaka, new neighbour at 42. Works nights at the airport. Has a staffie called Duke.
Catalina said her partner's leaving party on Saturday is off because he got the job extended another six months. So no party but good news.

kavya's first day at the new school went badly, the year 9s were a nightmare and someone set off the fire alarm. shes going to stick with it but sounded close to tears. her husband Darius is away on a work trip till thursday so shes on her own with the kids. message her friday to see if the week got better, maybe offer to have the little ones saturday

Abebe's son starts uni in Glasgow next Sunday, doing engineering. The whole family's driving him up on Saturday, then his wife is staying an extra few days to settle him in. Abebe says he's fine about it but he went very quiet when I asked. Also mentioned work want him to move to the Leeds site in the new year. Lot going on.

Long chat with Sadia. She's finally handing in her notice tomorrow, been building up to it for months. New role at the hospice starts 30 November 2026, it's less money but she says she'll actually be happy. Her manager doesn't know yet and she's dreading the conversation. Her sister Chioma's helping her draft the letter tonight. Remind me to text her tomorrow afternoon once it's done.
Darius mentioned his dad retires on Friday after 40 years on the buses. They're doing a family meal on Sunday.
To do this weekend: return the jacket, buy plant pots, get the bike tyre fixed, ring the council about the bin.
Rhys - just moved to Manchester, flat in Ancoats. Loving it so far. Does climbing and crossword.
Moira's leaving the choir, the rehearsals clash with her new night shifts.
Michael said Kevin's interview at the airline was today. Should drop Kevin a text tomorrow to ask how it went.
Nadia is pregnant!! Due mid May 2027. Her partner Jonah told me before she did lol, she was mortified
Hmm nothing much from lunch with Chidi, just work gossip. He's still at the bank, still hates the commute.

Paolo's starting a new job next Wednesday. He said his old boss threw him a surprise send-off at the pub and cried. Need to ask Paolo after his first week how he's finding it. Also his partner Kiara's birthday is the week after, and she's dropping hints about a fancy coffee grinder.
Gym membership renewal is 2 December 2026, cancel before then if I'm still not going.
